extract: recursive URL extraction follows document links discovered in results

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput
from xberg._xberg import ExtractionConfig

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput.from_json("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com\"}")
    config = ExtractionConfig.from_json("{\"url\":{\"crawl\":{\"document_url_depth\":1,\"follow_document_urls\":true,\"respect_robots_txt\":false},\"mode\":\"document\"}}")
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results)
    print(result.results[1].content)

asyncio.run(main())
```
